how_to_run: cd resources/tools/termopl && ./run_termopl.sh TXT_DIR WORK_DIR OUT_TSV 4   |   direct: cd resources/tools/termopl/TermoPL_Mac_OS_X && java -Djava.awt.headless=true -Xmx1500M -jar TermoPL.jar -SW -CP -CT -method gt -srch npmi3 -cntx 1 -save "# rank sf bf cvalue length freq_s freq_in context" -exp /abs/path/terms_all.tsv /abs/path/dir_with_conllu_files
notes: Installed from TermoPL_Mac_OS_X.zip (9,429,888 bytes, arm64 JNI libs) to resources/tools/termopl/TermoPL_Mac_OS_X (21 MB). Input must be tagged and lemmatised: .conllu (FORM, LEMMA, XPOS as NKJP-style tag; UPOS/HEAD/DEPREL only for -method ud) or flat 'form<TAB>lemma<TAB>tag' with empty line between sentences. Stanza CoNLL-U output is read as is (txt2conllu.py). No batch option for maximum term length: filter the exported 'length' column (run_termopl.sh does it). Must be started from its own directory, otherwise UnsatisfiedLinkError with exit status 0 and wrong output. Plain-text input does not work in batch mode (-python is ignored in 8.1.1). Directory arguments are read recursively and must contain only input files. Test: 402 tokens, 0.32 s, 127 terms.

tool: Morfeusz2 (Python module in main venv; also bundled in TermoPL)
notes: Was already installed; not changed. Gives all readings without disambiguation, so it cannot feed TermoPL alone. Used here to correct Stanza lemmas (txt2conllu.py --morfeusz-lemmas) and as the analyser in front of Concraft-pl (concraft/concraft_tag.py).

how_to_run: . .venv/bin/activate && python -c "import spacy; nlp = spacy.load('pl_core_news_lg'); print([(t.text, t.lemma_, t.tag_, str(t.morph)) for t in nlp('Błona komórkowa oddziela wnętrze komórki.')])"
notes: Installed and working in the main venv with 'python -m spacy download pl_core_news_lg' (wheel 573.7 MB, 611 MB on disk, 81 s); spacy validate reports it compatible with spaCy 3.8.18. LICENCE FLAG: the package declares GNU GPL 3.0 and lists its source 'UD Polish PDB v2.8' as GNU GPL 3.0, but UD_Polish-PDB states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 since release v2.4 (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UniversalDependencies/UD_Polish-PDB/master/LICENSE.txt). GPL 3.0 is copyleft. token.tag_ holds only the NKJP class (SUBST, ADJ); termopl/spacy2flat.py rebuilds a full tag from token.morph for TermoPL. pip left a copy of the wheel in ~/Library/Caches/pip (573,718,074 bytes).

version: resources 1.15.0 for Stanza 1.15.0: tokenize pdb_nocharlm, mwt pdb, pos pdb_charlm, lemma pdb_nocharlm, depparse pdb_charlm, ner nkjp
how_to_run: . .venv/bin/activate && python -c "import stanza; nlp = stanza.Pipeline('pl', dir='resources/tools/stanza_resources', processors='tokenize,mwt,pos,lemma', download_method=None, use_gpu=False); print([(w.text, w.lemma, w.xpos) for s in nlp('Fotosynteza zachodzi w chloroplastach.').sentences for w in s.words])"
notes: Installed and working: stanza.download('pl', model_dir='resources/tools/stanza_resources') (416 MB zip, deleted after unpacking; 436 MB on disk; 25 s). Load 1.8 s, one sentence 0.08 s on CPU. XPOS is the NKJP-style tag TermoPL expects. LICENCE FLAG: model card says Apache-2.0, but the training treebank UD_Polish-PDB is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 since v2.4 (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UniversalDependencies/UD_Polish-PDB/master/LICENSE.txt); Stanza docs say UD models use UD v2.12. Lemmatiser errors on domain words (dwutlenek -> dwutlenka, błonę -> błońa, fotosyntezy -> fotosyntez); use txt2conllu.py --morfeusz-lemmas. The download also left a copy of default.zip in ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/blobs/16/162b914981fee565eeda4a379678d7e24fd1a01e3ed48cf956349363eb9105c4 (416,036,108 bytes).
